fields.description: JavaScript code for a global-wide skill condition check.

fields.context: Runs during skill eligibility with this bound to the user; arguments[0] is the skill. The default declares user, target, a and b as this. Offline authoring validates syntax without running code.

fields.label: Use Updated Layout
fields.description: When true, the skill menu uses a full-width help window, a side skill-type command window beside actor status, and the skill list below. LayoutStyle chooses help and command positions. False retains the native scene rectangles; list columns and command appearance still apply.
fields.nativeDefault: true

fields.label: Layout Style
fields.description: Position the help window above (upper) or below (lower) the menu and the skill-type commands left or right. For example upper/right puts help above and commands at the right. Applies with EnableLayout=true. Options Core Custom menu style overrides these positions when uiMenuStyle=true: uiHelpPosition false/true chooses top/bottom and uiInputPosition false/true chooses left/right. In the options namespace, describe OPT-ITEM-2-17, OPT-ITEM-2-18 and OPT-ITEM-2-19 for these player-facing choices; Recommended (uiMenuStyle=false) leaves this layout selection in control.
fields.nativeDefault: upper/left
fields.default: upper/left

fields.label: Style
fields.description: Draw skill-type commands as text, icon, iconText, or auto. Auto uses icon plus text when it fits, otherwise icon alone; without an icon it uses text. Icons come from a \I[n] code in the type name or IconStypeNorm/IconStypeMagic.
fields.nativeDefault: auto
fields.default: auto

fields.label: Text Align
fields.description: Align skill-type command text: left, center or right. Use one of these strings; unrecognized strings have no defined authoring contract. Icon-only commands are centered independently.
fields.nativeDefault: left
fields.default: left

fields.label: Window Width
fields.description: Pixel width of the skill-type command window in the skill menu. The updated layout places actor status in the remaining width; changing this value also supplies the native scene command-width hook.

fields.label: Columns
fields.description: Maximum columns in the skill list outside battle, including the skill menu with either native or updated layout. Use a positive whole number; battle keeps its own column configuration.

fields.label: Show in Skill Menu?
fields.description: With an active Items/Equips Core provider, show its selected-skill information panel beside the skill list when EnableLayout=false. The updated layout creates this panel whenever that provider is present, even if this option is false. Without the provider there is no panel.
fields.nativeDefault: true

fields.label: Adjust List Window?
fields.description: With EnableLayout=false and a visible Items/Equips information panel, subtract the panel width from the skill-list width. False retains the native list width. The updated layout always reserves panel width itself.
fields.nativeDefault: true

fields.label: Background Type
fields.description: Background of the selected-skill information panel: 0 is a normal window, 1 is dim, 2 is transparent. Requires the Items/Equips panel described by SS-P-Skills-ShowShopStatus.

fields.label: JS: X, Y, W, H
fields.description: JavaScript body called when creating the selected-skill information panel with EnableLayout=false and an active Items/Equips provider. this is the current skill-menu scene. Return new Rectangle(x,y,width,height), in screen pixels from top-left; x grows right and y down. this._itemWindow is the skill-list window (x,y,width,height); this.shopStatusWidth() gives the panel width; Graphics.boxWidth is screen width. The updated layout computes its own rectangle and ignores this body.

fields.label: Icon: Normal Type
fields.description: Fallback IconSet index for non-magic skill types without a \I[n] code in their Database > Types name. Choose the number from the MZ icon picker using img/system/IconSet.png. Magic types are those selected in Database > System > Magic Skills; other types use this fallback. CmdStyle=text omits the automatic icon.

fields.label: Icon: Magic Type
fields.description: Fallback IconSet index for skill types selected in Database > System > Magic Skills, unless their Database > Types name contains \I[n]. Choose n using the MZ icon picker for img/system/IconSet.png. Other types use IconStypeNorm; CmdStyle=text omits the automatic icon.

fields.label: Name
fields.description: Name identifying a resource, matched case-insensitively for replacement gauges and MP/TP cost queries. The default TextJS also uses it as the visible label. Use unique names: name lookup selects the first match, while the full array still processes every entry. Renaming MP or TP disconnects that named query/gauge lookup, but does not rewrite hard-coded notetags or callback code. For custom Foco, configure its callbacks and reference Foco in a replacement-gauge tag.

tags.label: remove state category
tags.description: On the action target, remove states matching this category. All attempts every matching state; a nonnegative integer attempts only the first N matches (0 does nothing), in the battler states() order: priority descending across applied and passive entries; equal-priority applied states retain native ID order and precede equal-priority appended passives. Passive matches can occupy a counted slot but removeState does not withdraw their passive sources. Use All to avoid that counting limitation when clearing all applied matches. Category names ignore case and surrounding spaces.
tags.context: Native database Notes. Offline editing does not apply effects.

tags.label: remove other states
tags.description: Remove other states of the named category when this state is added.
tags.context: Native database Notes. Offline editing does not apply effects.

tags.label: buff turns
tags.description: On the action target, adjust or set duration only for an existing matching buff (positive level) or debuff (negative level). Without Set, add the signed number to remaining turns; with Set, replace them. Clamp to 0..Buffs.MaxTurns. These tags do not add an absent effect or alter its level; setting duration to zero does not immediately remove its level, which the normal automatic expiration handles.
tags.context: Native database Notes. Offline editing does not apply effects.

tags.label: passive switch on

tags.description: Hide this applied state turn counter.
tags.context: Insert the tag in Database > States > Notes for the chosen state, or edit that state through the public tags interface. The state must be applied and its icon displayed to observe the turn text; States.ShowTurns must be true. Offline validation does not draw the game UI.

tags.label: state-turn-color
tags.description: Override state turn text color with a window color index or #rrggbb. Numeric indices select colors from the MZ Window.png text palette through ColorManager.textColor (normally 0–31). Hex colors directly specify red/green/blue, for example #f08040. This override takes priority over neutral/positive/negative turn colors.
